shortDefinition.en: An offset that asks an automatic exposure system for a brighter or darker target than its unmodified proposal.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 要求自动曝光系统采用比原始建议更亮或更暗目标的偏移量。

en: Positive compensation does not always add light; the result depends on which settings remain automatic.
zh-cn: 正补偿不一定增加进光；结果取决于哪些设置仍处于自动状态。

example.en: In aperture priority with fixed ISO, +1 EV commonly produces a longer shutter time for a brighter target.
example.zh-cn: 在固定 ISO 的光圈优先模式下，+1 EV 通常会通过更长快门时间实现更亮目标。
